answer: 4,251 non-reference exonic variant records remain in CHIP genes across the 86 samples. After removing reference calls (Zygosity 'Reference' or blank) and intronic, intergenic (upstream_gene_variant), and UTR variants, and restricting to the 56 Schenz et al. (2022) CHIP genes, the 86 per-sample workbooks contain 4,251 qualifying non-reference exonic variant–sample records (synonymous 2,795; missense 934; splice-region 436; frameshift 78; in-frame insertion 8), spanning 47 of the 56 CHIP genes and 295 unique genomic variants. Sensitivity: 3,815 if 'exonic' is restricted to CDS (protein-coding) consequences only, excluding splice-region variants.
